name: Quill
subtitle: Your story, one beat at a time
localizedDescription:
Your story starts here. Quill is a writing workspace for iPhone and iPad, with a companion browser app. Write everything yourself, call on AI when you need a hand, and keep your story organized from the first idea to the final page.

A BOOKSHELF OF YOUR OWN
Start at an illustrated writing desk, open the animated bookshelf, and give each book its own cover. Open a book to reach its Codex, manuscript, and saved drafts. Custom artwork, clear action icons, light and dark themes, and reduced-motion options make the workspace your own.

WRITE ONE BEAT AT A TIME
The manuscript editor is your starting point. Generate opens a chapter beat planner so you can write or review the map before generating each beat individually. Show beats to edit separate blocks by hand or ask AI for a revision. Prompt the next beat directly below your writing, or select a word, sentence, or paragraph to Revise, Rephrase, or find contextual Synonyms. Review suggestions before applying them; saved revisions and partial drafts keep your work recoverable.

YOUR STORY'S CODEX
Keep the story summary, plot beats, writing style, and character profiles together for the AI to reference. Build characters yourself or generate editable profiles covering appearance, personality, backstory, motivation, relationships, and arcs. Upload portraits or generate them with Apple Image Playground on supported devices. Ask for the next plot beat when you need inspiration.

READ AND REVIEW YOUR MANUSCRIPT
Update from manuscript proposes missing Codex context, developments, and character details for you to review. The Plot holes section looks for possible contradictions and missing links, with supporting evidence and possible fixes. Track findings as open, resolved, or dismissed. AI findings are suggestions for the author to assess.

FROM DEDICATION TO EPILOGUE
Add and reorder title and copyright pages, dedication, epigraph, contents, foreword, preface, introduction, prologue, chapters, interludes, epilogue, afterword, acknowledgments, appendix, glossary, bibliography, an author page, and custom sections. Use formatted writing, focus mode, spell check, search, word counts, and goals. Export Word, EPUB, HTML, plain text, or print/PDF.

MANAGE DRAFTS AND MODELS
Each book has its own Drafts area to review, export, or delete unwanted beat maps, writing attempts, and Codex suggestions. Manage Models lets you choose, download, update, or remove models to free storage. Downloads show their percentage beside the name and a progress bar.

CHOOSE YOUR AI
Use Apple Intelligence on supported devices, or download Qwen, Llama, and Gemma models. Compatible WebGPU browsers also offer Qwen, Llama, and SmolLM2. Connect your own model through an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic Messages API. Local models have no AI usage fees; initial downloads, compatible hardware, storage, and memory are required. Optional API providers may charge and receive the story context used for generation. Apple controls Intelligence and Image Playground availability.

SAVE AND TAKE YOUR STORY WITH YOU
Automatic local saving, revision history, recoverable deleted items, full backups, and optional shared-folder sync help keep your writing available. Your writing stays on your device by default. iCloud Drive folder sync works while the app is open; desktop Chrome and Edge can share that folder, while other browsers use backup import/export.

Requires iOS 16 or later; AI features have additional device requirements. Install through AltStore Classic.

Browser app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/

NEW EDITING TOOLS
Automatic offline English spell checking underlines unrecognized words in red; tap for corrections or review later with manual Spell Check. Select writing to Revise, Rephrase a passage, or choose a Synonym for one word. Find & Replace visits highlighted manuscript matches with previous/next arrows, replaces one at a time by default, and offers an optional Replace all checkbox. Adjust writer text size and enjoy larger beat editing areas. Insert export-ready page breaks at the cursor. Generate the next beat with an optional description. Customize the default beat prompt in Settings for clear prose, less repetition, concrete story progress and scene continuity; the latest manuscript ending is kept in context. Open-book page controls turn to the Codex or resume your last edited section.
